# Typace

> Typace is an independent type design project creating distinctive, practical typefaces for digital and creative use.

## Canonical URLs

- Homepage: https://typace.ace-base.cc/
- Font files: https://typace.ace-base.cc/fonts/
- Font catalog API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/fonts
- Search API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/search?q=QUERY
- Individual font API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/fonts/SLUG
- Dynamic CSS API: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/css/SLUG
- OpenAPI specification: https://typace.ace-base.cc/api/openapi.json

## Dynamic font catalog

Typace discovers supported font files dynamically from the deployed `/fonts` directory. Do not hardcode the font catalog.

Supported formats are determined by the files currently present:
- `.ttf` (TrueType)
- `.otf` (OpenType)
- `.woff`
- `.woff2`

The authoritative catalog is `GET /api/fonts`.

Each record includes:
- `name`
- `file`
- `type`
- `format`
- `url`
- `createdAt`
- `updatedAt`
- optional `isNew`

Use returned metadata as the source of truth. Do not invent designer, license, weight, style, glyph coverage, variable-axis, or OpenType-feature information when it is not published.

## Search

Use `GET /api/search?q=QUERY` for dynamic name, filename, type, and format matching.

## Web usage

Use `GET /api/css/SLUG` for a ready-to-use `@font-face` declaration. Otherwise use the `url` and `format` fields from the catalog API. Do not assume every font is TTF.

## Documentation

- Human-readable documentation: https://docs.ace-base.cc/projects/typace
- The Ace Base documentation index: https://docs.ace-base.cc/
- Machine-readable Typace documentation: https://typace.ace-base.cc/llms.txt

Use the human-readable documentation for integration guides and conceptual explanations. Use the live API and OpenAPI specification for current catalog and endpoint details.

## Licensing

Each typeface has its own licensing terms. Check the applicable license before commercial use, redistribution, modification, embedding, or inclusion in software.

## Machine-readable specification

The OpenAPI document at `/api/openapi.json` describes the API routes.
